confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from an RBA search result: 0.6720 USD per AUD, dated 18 Nov 2026. I ran two searches. The food and drink figures rest on crowdsourced and blog sources that are often old or based on few contributors: Numbeo, Wise, Digital Nomads World and Travel Guides Tip. Beer is about 80-120 THB. Cappuccino is about $2-3. The cocktail figure (150-250 THB) comes from one blog-style source. Wine by the glass is not directly sourced. I set it at about 2.5 times the beer price, using a mid-range bottle of about $19 as a cross-check. The inexpensive meal is set above the very low crowdsourced figures ($1.50-3) because tourist-area Koh Lanta venues usually charge more. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from any listings. Koh Lanta is strongly seasonal and July falls in the low and monsoon season, so prices may be lower. Hostel supply is limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Andaman island destinations such as Koh Phi Phi, Koh Lipe and Krabi's Railay and Ao Nang beaches. Prices are somewhat above mainland southern Thailand and below Phuket and Koh Samui.
